include { GATK4_APPLYBQSR } from 'nf-core/gatk4/applybqsr'
include { SAMTOOLS_MERGE  } from 'nf-core/samtools/merge'

workflow BAM_APPLYBQSR {
    take:
    input // channel: [mandatory] [ meta, reads, index, recal ]
    references // channel: [mandatory] [ meta, fasta, fai, dict ]
    intervals // channel: [mandatory] [ intervals, num_intervals ] or [ [], 0 ] if no intervals
    output_format // tuple: [mandatory] [ file_type, index_format ] — ['bam','bai'], ['bam','csi'], or ['cram','crai']

    main:
    reads_interval = input
        .combine(intervals)
        .map { meta, reads_, index, recal, intervals_, num_intervals ->
            [meta + [num_intervals: num_intervals, interval: intervals_.name], reads_, index, recal, intervals_]
        }

    // RUN APPLYBQSR
    GATK4_APPLYBQSR(reads_interval, references, output_format)

    reads_applybqsr = GATK4_APPLYBQSR.out.reads
        .join(GATK4_APPLYBQSR.out.index, failOnMismatch: true)
        .branch { meta, _reads, _index ->
            single: meta.num_intervals <= 1
            multiple: meta.num_intervals > 1
        }

    // For multiple intervals, gather and merge the recalibrated files
    reads_to_merge = reads_applybqsr.multiple
        .map { meta, reads, index ->
            def merge_meta = meta - meta.subMap('interval')
            [groupKey(merge_meta, merge_meta.num_intervals), reads, index]
        }
        .groupTuple()

    SAMTOOLS_MERGE(reads_to_merge, references.map { meta, fasta, fai, _dict -> [meta, fasta, fai, []] }, output_format[1])

    // Unified output — bam or cram depending on what was produced
    recal_out = SAMTOOLS_MERGE.out.bam
        .mix(SAMTOOLS_MERGE.out.cram)
        .join(SAMTOOLS_MERGE.out.index, failOnMismatch: true)
        .mix(reads_applybqsr.single)
        .map { meta, reads, index -> [meta - meta.subMap('num_intervals', 'interval'), reads, index] }

    emit:
    recal_out = recal_out // channel: [ meta, reads, index ]
}

---
name: "nf-core/bam_applybqsr"
description: "Apply Base Quality Score Recalibration (BQSR) to a BAM or CRAM file\
  \ using\nGATK4 ApplyBQSR. Supports scatter-gather across genomic intervals: when\n\
  more than one interval file is supplied per sample, the interval-level\noutputs\
  \ are merged back together with samtools merge. When no intervals\nare supplied\
  \ (num_intervals: 0), ApplyBQSR is run once on the whole\ninput and no merge step\
  \ is performed.\n"
keywords:
- "bam"
- "cram"
- "bqsr"
- "recalibration"
- "gatk4"
components:
- "gatk4/applybqsr"
- "samtools/merge"
input:
- input:
    type: "file"
    description: "BAM or CRAM file to recalibrate, its index, and the recalibration\n\
      table produced by GATK4 BaseRecalibrator.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(reads),\
      \ path(index), path(recal) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{bam,cram}"
- references:
    type: "file"
    description: "Reference genome fasta file, its index, and the GATK sequence dictionary.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta2), path(fasta), path(fai), path(dict) ]\n"
- intervals:
    type: "file"
    description: "Bed file (or interval_list) with the genomic regions to restrict\n\
      recalibration to, together with the number of interval files being\nprocessed\
      \ for this sample. Pass [ [], 0 ] to run without intervals.\n\nStructure: [\
      \ path(intervals), val(num_intervals) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{bed,interval_list}"
- output_format:
    type: "tuple"
    description: "Output file type and index format as a two-element tuple, passed\
      \ to\nGATK4 ApplyBQSR (which validates the combination) and to samtools merge.\n\
      First element: 'bam' or 'cram'.\nSecond element: 'bai', 'csi', or 'crai'.\n\n\
      Valid combinations: ['bam', 'bai'], ['bam', 'csi'], ['cram', 'crai'].\n"
    pattern: "{bam,cram}"
output:
- recal_out:
    type: "file"
    description: "Recalibrated BAM or CRAM file and its index. If more than one interval\n\
      was used, this is the merged output; otherwise it is the direct\nApplyBQSR output.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(reads), path(index) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{bam,cram}"
authors:
- "@agrima2010"
maintainers:
- "@agrima2010"
- "@maxulysse"
version: "0.0.0-df69bf6"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/gatk4/applybqsr@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/samtools/merge@0.0.0-df69bf6"
